title: Adrian
author: Adrian P.
desc: Introducing the Adrian program, a focused one-week workout designed for those looking to maximize their leg strength with just one session. This program features two powerhouse exercises: the Barbell Squat and the Leg Press, targeting your quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings for a comprehensive lower body workout. Each exercise is accompanied by instructional videos to ensure proper form and technique. Commit to this intense session and feel the burn as you build strength and power in your legs!
